Record the decision: Sign (signer Patient; or DecisionMaker, with a relationship GET /consent-decision-makers allows for this patient: an adult uses adult_priority, a child minor_priority, else CONSENT_SIGNER_INVALID; the questions and answers; a tick 'the patient explained it back'), or Refuse with the reason (VerbalRefusal: witnessed).
